anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: some partake of his head, some of hands, some of breast, others also of his inwards, others also of the thighs, and some even of the feet, where fleshes are not more, each partaking from him according to his own power.
pass_b_english: [some partake of his head, some of hands, some of breast, others also of his inwards, others also of the thighs, and some even of the feet, where there is] not [more] flesh, [each] partaking [from him] according to [his own] power.
source_text: [οἱ μὲν τῆς κεφαλῆς μεταλαμβάνουσιν αὐτοῦ, οἱ δὲ χειρῶν, οἱ δὲ στήθους, ἄλλοι καὶ τῶν ἐντοσθιδίων αὐτοῦ, ἕτεροι καὶ τῶν μηρῶν, τινὲς δὲ καὶ τῶν ποδῶν, ἔνθα σάρ]κ[ες οὐ πλείονες, ἑκάστου] κατὰ τ[ὴν ἰδίαν μεταλαμβά]νοντος δύ[ναμιν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.]
